ORDERING SEGREGATION GUIDELINES
Seasoning mix orders need to be separated to two separate companies, who each provide half of the mix (new Mexico facility combines spices 1 through 6, local Kentucky facility mixes remaining 5 spices, currently). The two separate deliveries should be mixed at CFC Distributions HQ and placed in unmarked white bags for franchise level distribution.
Prepared bags of the seasoning mix are sent to franchises, where it is combined with a flour, powdered egg, dried milk and salt breading mix in store to create final product. This ensures no digital copies of the secret recipe are ever distributed in their enteritis.

At Kernel's Food Corner, we have one mission: serve the world's best tasting chicken. So we start with only the best ingredients, whole chicken that's delivered fresh. Then it's prepared fresh, hand-breaded in our own secret recipes and cooked fresh for you by certified CFC cooks in every one of our restaurants. Easy? No. But it only takes one bite to remember why all that extra effort is worthwhile. Because fresh tastes better. Stop by your local CFC and taste for yourself.
